observations.why: The contrast explicitly values self-originated ownership over dependence on externally rented capability.
Keeping one's perspective is presented as the retained, self-directed value, contrasted with a replaceable substrate.
The sentence names and ratifies an individual ownership orientation, but adds no distinct value pattern beyond the ownership claim.
